transcript.text: Back in 2025 I did that quick food trip to Guangzhou, and I remember just wandering around and comparing places in my head the whole time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later that year I was in Nanjing for a weekend and ended up talking about movies nonstop, since everyone there kept debating what to watch.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For that Guangzhou dinner, our group ended up at Bingsheng Restaurant, and it was actually on 2025-05-12.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I still remember the dinner slot was 19:00, and there were 6 of us squeezed around the table.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Funny detail: the reservation was under John Smith, and the contact number they left was 13812345678.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And in Nanjing, my friend Lin Bo had already gotten two seats for Article 20 at Wanda Cinema Xinjiekou, the 15:30 showtime.
